worldCopy.opening: These tribes need you. Answer their prayers, keep them alive and lift them through the ages, or see what becomes of them without you.
worldCopy.closing: Your world saves on this device. Settings has photo mode, export, a fresh world, and this tour again.

world.title: Your world
world.text: Every tiny figure is a real person with a name, a family and beliefs, living their own life. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, click anyone to follow them.

prayer.title: When they need you
prayer.text: A bubble over a tribe is a prayer: hunger, sickness, fire, danger. Click it to answer and win their faith. When a tribe is on the brink, ⚠ lights up in the header.

powers.title: Your powers
powers.text: Everything you can do to the world. Pick a tool, then click the map; Esc puts it down. Pause and speed are on the right.

history.title: Watch history unfold
history.text: Stats, civilization, search and chronicles: eras, religions, wars, and the stories this world writes about itself.
